# Beebo Entertainment
> Free, local-first media server and apps: your own movies, TV, music, photos, audiobooks and live TV, streamed from your own computer to phones, TVs, cars and browsers, with camp and road-trip features. This file points to our public testing record.

## Current downloads (October 5, 2026)
- Windows server 0.1.79: Available. Not code-signed, so Windows may warn the first time. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/windows.html
- Android phone app 1.51-tester12 (build 62): Available as a test download from this site. Not on Google Play. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/app-on-your-phone.html
- Beebo Auto (Android Auto) 1.16 (build 17): Available as a test download. Not on Google Play and never tested in a real car. Use only when parked. https://www.beeboentertainment.com/car-companion.html
- Machine-readable version files: https://www.beeboentertainment.com/desktop-version.json, https://www.beeboentertainment.com/downloads/app-build.json, https://www.beeboentertainment.com/downloads/auto-build.json

## Status by platform (from the What's tested page)
- Available: Windows 10 and 11 server, Android phones and tablets (test download), any web browser, Beebo Auto (test download).
- Beta: Android TV and Google TV, Chromecast casting, Amazon Fire TV, Roku, LG and Samsung smart TVs, Xbox, Linux desktop, Docker and NAS server, macOS, iPhone and iPad, Apple TV.
- In development: Android on Google Play.

## Status by feature (from the What's tested page)
- Available: your library, player and web player; Campsite games.
- Beta: watching away from home (direct, then Beebo Relay), Campsite "stream once" for guests, Watch Together, Car Party, Campsite walkie-talkie, translations, compatible third-party app mode, Live TV with your own tuner, Beebo Relay, Link a TV, library sharing between households, Story Studio, Remote Desktop, BeeboVPN, online games with people in other homes.

- [What's new and what's tested](https://www.beeboentertainment.com/whats-tested.html): what changed, platform and feature status, real-device results with dates and tallies, and what is not tested yet.

## Honesty note
We never claim a flat "100% working". Percentages are checks passed out of checks planned. Untested paths are listed as not tested.
